baseline_prompt_en: Create a photographic fiction with a focal character at a visible relationship encounter. The supplied image serves as an appearance reference for the focal character: preserve the visible soft oval face, brown eyes, straight dark jaw-length bob and fine parted bangs. This is an independently imagined adult woman and three independently imagined adult male suitors in a fictional royal court. At the palace ferry landing just after a diplomatic banquet, her waiting departure has turned into a contest of intimate farewells. She stands near the middle of a broad stone landing in a deep teal silk evening gown, holding her small travel case beside her left leg. A tall dark-haired suitor at her right bends toward the back of her offered right hand, his left hand lightly supporting her fingers as he kisses them; she allows the kiss but turns her face toward a second suitor on her left, who offers a single red camellia at her chest height with an unguarded, hopeful smile. Her small involuntary smile answers the flower while her hand remains with the first man. A third, silver-haired suitor stands a pace behind her left shoulder, presenting an open velvet ring box toward her with both hands; his gaze slips from her face to the hand-kissing rival, and his tense mouth makes the competing romantic claim readable. Their attention converges on the same woman, while her delayed step and divided response leave her choice unresolved. Every hand belongs to its clearly separated arm; the kiss, flower and open box occupy separate patches of space. The men wear individually distinct burgundy, cream and charcoal court coats. An empty narrow royal ferry waits beside the landing, its mooring rope slack against the stone; warm palace windows behind them and a pale streak of dawn over the water make departure feel imminent. Photograph from the landward side at eye level in a horizontal three-quarter-length group frame, keeping all four faces, the complete kiss contact, the flower and ring box clear together. Use natural skin texture, the cool river dawn against warm lantern light, restrained silk highlights and quietly observed romantic tension, with the focal woman's poised presence leading the frame.
